frame: 0x507 CarMakerDriverSteering (internal HIL transport, CarMaker -> SpeedgoatHIL on the CarMaker bus / IO614 channel 1)
provisional: CAN ID 0x507 is PROVISIONAL -- no authoritative vehicle-wide CAN ID registry exists; team approval still required.
derivation: Hand-derived from BO_ 1287 in carmaker/config/MFE26_Inverter_CarMaker.dbc. NOT produced by running decodeCarMakerSteeringFrame.m or IO.c.
scaling: angle 0.1 deg/bit, speed 0.5 (deg/s)/bit, both signed int16
integrity: byte 6 alive counter mod 256; byte 7 CRC-8/SAE-J1850 over bytes 0-6 (poly 0x1D, init 0xFF, non-reflected, xorout 0xFF)
signConvention: left-hand-positive (CarMaker / ISO 8855, matching the Bosch LWS)
downstream: The SpeedgoatHIL LWS emulator, not CarMaker, turns this into the Bosch LWS 0x2B0 frame. 0x507 never reaches the VC bus.

accepted.name: cmsteer_one_lsb_angle
accepted.note: angle LSB = 0.1 deg, matching the Bosch LWS_ANGLE resolution

accepted.name: cmsteer_full_left
accepted.note: Bosch LWS measuring range +780 deg; TorqueVect saturates here

accepted.name: cmsteer_full_right
accepted.note: Bosch LWS measuring range -780 deg; counter about to wrap 255->0

accepted.name: cmsteer_counter_wrap
accepted.note: counter wrapped 255->0; a decoder must treat this as advancing

accepted.name: cmsteer_fast_sweep
accepted.note: a fast hand sweep; 3000 speed counts = 0x0BB8 LE. Well within the +/-3600 deg/s transport range; the LWS packer clamps to 1016.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_short_dlc
rejected.expectation: REJECT wrong_dlc. The frame is always DLC 8.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_reserved_nonzero
rejected.expectation: REJECT reserved_nonzero. Byte 4 must be zero; a non-zero reserved byte flags a mis-scaled sender.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_bad_crc
rejected.expectation: REJECT integrity_failure. Byte 7 is not the CRC-8/SAE-J1850 of bytes 0-6.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_angle_over_range
rejected.expectation: REJECT out_of_range. 9000 counts = 900.0 deg exceeds the Bosch +/-780 deg range; the previous retained value is kept.

rejected.name: cmsteer_reject_extended
rejected.expectation: REJECT extended_frame. 0x507 is an 11-bit standard ID.
